"""Local stand-in for public_check.py (this sandbox denies setsid).
Builds from a frozen copy of src/ and runs the seven public fixtures."""
import json, runpy, subprocess, sys, shutil, tempfile
from pathlib import Path
HERE=Path('/workspace')
bm=runpy.run_path(str(HERE/'build.py'), run_name='public_build_helpers')
folder=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(dir=HERE/'tmp'))
frozen=folder/'src'
bm['collect'](HERE/'src', frozen)
r=subprocess.run([sys.executable,str(HERE/'build.py'),'--source',str(frozen),'--output',str(folder/'scamptrie')],capture_output=True,cwd=str(HERE))
print(r.stdout.decode()[-200:], r.stderr.decode()[-2000:], 'rc',r.returncode)
assert r.returncode==0
sys.path.insert(0,str(HERE))
from public_sanity import check_response, strict_loads
fixtures=json.loads((HERE/'examples/checks.json').read_text())
env=dict(PATH='/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin',HOME='/workspace',LANG='C',LC_ALL='C',
         TMPDIR=str(HERE/'tmp'),PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE='1',PYTHONUNBUFFERED='1',PYTHONHASHSEED='0',
         SCAMP_BINARY=str(folder/'scamptrie'))
fails=0
for fx in fixtures:
    data=fx['input'].encode()
    p=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'-I','-B',str(HERE/'run.py')],input=data,capture_output=True,env=env,cwd=str(HERE),timeout=200)
    try:
        response=strict_loads(p.stdout)
        check_response(fx,response)
        print('PASS',fx['name'])
    except Exception as e:
        fails+=1
        print('FAIL',fx['name'],repr(e),p.stdout[:300],p.stderr[:300])
shutil.rmtree(folder)
sys.exit(1 if fails else 0)
PY
python3 tmp/pub_sim.py
